Title: Secrets of the Swamp
Description: Collect Ancient Stone Tablets and Rubbings from any Ancient Plaques within Sunken Aspect, and return them to Legatus Fulvius in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: A question I ask myself every day, but of course, the answer is that it's my duty, as a citizen of New Corsica and of Aeternum.
InProgressResponse: I've only just learned of these tablets, but I have high hopes. Bring back the tablets and charcoal rubbings and I'll share whatever I can translate.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Aha! Did I mention I'm a scholar of the Ancients' language? I've spent centuries studying - let's see what I can decipher here...

Title: Hope Springs Eternal
Description: Investigate the Ancient ruins of Skyview Repose, and return to Legatus Fulvius in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I absolutely agree. There's only one additional clue I can decipher from the writings you procured.
InProgressResponse: Healing waters in the mountains… why would the Ancients sends their servants there?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Aha, you've returned! Unlike Abbington... at any rate, let's see what you found.

Title: Paths Unseen
Description: Colllect any remnants of the Ancients you can find in Rackham's Hollow. Then report to Legatus Fulvius in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Well, the map you recovered seems to locate the source of the devices used in the rituals.
InProgressResponse: Be wary in the caves. I've heard the Lost have domain there. But if it gives us clues about the Ancients' technologies, it's worth any risk.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Thank the gods you've returned! I was beginning to worry! And what are these...?

Title: Anatomy of the Heart
Description: Search for any remaining Ancient artifacts within the ruins of Sha Makogai. Then report to Legatus Fulvius in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The ruins of Sha Makogai - they appear to have been the seat of the Ancients' power in this region.
InProgressResponse: The ruins of Sha Makogai have been explored before, but perhaps something remains there of interest.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You have proven quite capable, my friend, and helpful too. Let me see what you've recovered.

Title: Seek and Hide
Description: Uncover the whereabouts of Antiquarian Abbingdon, last sent to Syleio Seko.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It means we need to find Abbington - he knows more than I do about this business.
InProgressResponse: Please, make haste. If Abbington has not returned by now, it could be bad. We need him, or his work, at least.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Stellar timing! I knew Fulvius would eventually send someone. But I couldn't leave behind this artifact I've discovered… of course, I can't seem to collect it, either.

Title: Secrets Best Left Unshared
Description: Distract the Starvault Guardians while Antiquarian Abbingdon frees the Ancient artifact.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Because THIS is what he's after - an artifact the Ancients used to extract souls and turn them into Azoth!
InProgressResponse: Distract the Starvault Guardians downstairs, and I'll pry the relic loose. We can do this - we have to.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: What news, my friend? I feel we are close to finding the secrets of the Ancients here. Tell me, did you find Abbington? What happened to the old fool?

Title: An Expanding Threat
Description: Investigate the Lost Pirates at Maria's Rest. Then report to Headmen Onizuka in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The Lost, the empty vessels… the Siren Queen. I told them, but others here are only concerned with the Angry Earth.
InProgressResponse: Go on now, go to Maria's Rest and see for yourself. Defeat as many pirates as you can, but it will not be enough.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: [BLANK]

Title: Defiance and Doubt
Description: Track down the Pirate deserter, possibly hiding out in Shipflight Comb in Reekwater.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: This final note mentions a town to the northwest. From Maria's Rest, that would be Shipflight Comb. I would start there.
InProgressResponse: Shipflight Comb was once a bustling town, full of energy and life. What changed there, no one knows. No one, except the spirits that remain.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Don't kill me, please! Mercy! I'm not… not with them. Not anymore! Not for a long time really…

Title: A Hunger for Freedom
Description: Find, craft, or purchase Meager Meals and Fresh Water for Katring Sanders in Reekwater.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Oh, because she's gonna take the whole island. I mean, she's... wait - you're working me!
InProgressResponse: I'll tell you what the Siren Queen's all about, but you gotta get me some grub first. Berries, hardtack, an old shoe - I'll eat anything at this point.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh, sweet mother ocean... praise you! This'll keep me fed for... I don't know how long.

Title: Queen's Gambit
Description: Destroy the mysterious Cursed Banners throughout Reekwater, then return to Katring Sanders.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Harnessing the island's magic, I figure. She's made these strange... 'banners' outta flotsam and relics.
InProgressResponse: Good luck tearing down those banners. I mean it may be the only hope, but don't ask me to do it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Well now, look who's played the odds and lived to tell! You're pretty mean scallywag, aren't you? Not as mean as the Queen, mind you, but you got salt.

Title: Shivering Timbers
Description: Put a stop to the salvage operations at Scavenger's Shore and Bleachwood Coast, and report back to Headman Onizuka in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: That's when I hid, but they started getting salvage for those banners from all the wrecks on the shoreline.
InProgressResponse: I think I'll be staying here. Like I said, it's safer. I mean you got salt, but if I was a betting woman -  and I am - I'd bet on the Siren Queen. No offense!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: At long last, you return! I was beginning to think you might've joined the Siren Queen's crew!

Title: Words of Power
Description: Search Syleio Seko for clues about the Siren Queen's plans. Then report to Headman Onizuka in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes, and we must find out what that is. You have learned of this Ancient 'machine' she took from the ruins, yes?
InProgressResponse: We must know what the Siren Queen ultimately seeks to accomplish before we attempt to confront her.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Bless the winds that brought you back. Let me see, what clues did you find at the Lighthouse?

Title: A Plan's Deconstruction
Description: Destroy the twisted Ancient relics in Mistywater Thorp. Then report to Headman Onizuka in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Before now, I would not have thought so, but it does confirm my suspicions. The Siren Queen has the potential to become an even greater theat than the Corruption.
InProgressResponse: I believe the Siren Queen's crew is using the relics to create more of these banners they put up across the territory. You must put a stop to this.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You have done well. There are already reports that there are fewer of those cursed banners.

Title: The Queen is Dead (Elite)
Description: Hunt down the Siren Queen's lieutenants, destroy the Ancient Machine, and defeat the Siren Queen. Then report to Headman Onizuka in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ha! Well said! Now, the Siren Queen’s lieutenants have spread throughout that hodgepodge 'fortress' to the south.
InProgressResponse: After you light off that gunpowder, the Siren Queen won’t be pleased at all. You and your allies will need to be ready for the fierce battle ahead of you.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: We saw the plume of smoke from here, and heard the lightning strikes of the Siren Queen's fury! Since you made it back... can I assume she has been dealt with?

Title: Long Live the Queen (Elite)
Description: Hunt down the Siren Queen's lieutenants, acquire a key, and defeat the Siren Queen.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Sadly, no. Elsewhere on Aeternum, could take a week to come back... around here, it's always faster. Must be something in the water.
InProgressResponse: Go on, off with you. You’ve things to do, I’ve things to do, and standing around won’t make any of them happen faster.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: @0510_0101_longlivethequeen_complete_available_response
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: It's only a matter of time before the Siren Queen regains her strength and returns. You'll be the first to know when that happens.

Title: On Floral Fauna
Description: Retrieve the Dryad journals dropped by Herbalist Langlais in the Glimmerfen. Then return it to her in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: These lands are sacred to nature, and any affront to nature on Aeternum will cause a reaction here.
InProgressResponse: My journals contain decades of insights regarding Reekwater and the Angry Earth. They must be reclaimed or all my work will have been in vain.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh praise the Earth mother you've returned! These journals are everything to me.

Title: Pruning and Irrigation
Description: Provide Marsh Walker Afolabi with her requested fresh Dryad Cuttings from the Glimmerfen, and Azoth Water from Azoth Springs.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Because she has much to learn, and her growth can only be accelerate by adversity… but you have done no harm.
InProgressResponse: The fresh Dryad samples and Azoth water will give us greater insights. Trust the process, young one.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Thank you, child. Some might shy away from the Dryads when they seethe as they do. You are brave.

Title: New Growth
Description: Search the Virid Grotto for Azoth crystals, and bring pieces of them back for Marsh Walker Afolabi in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I am, but first, I ask your assistance in addressing a concern of my own.
InProgressResponse: The Dryads in the grotto are enraged to a degree unlike any time I've seen in the past. Do take care collecting the crystals.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Your return warms my blood, young one. Let me see these crystals.

Title: Excising the Blighted Root
Description: Hunt down The Blight Bringer and any Blight Nodules in Lambent Muskeg, then travel to Fisher's Glory to ensure the Blight has not spread. Then report to Herbalist Langlais in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The greatest factor in the destabilization of nature now is of course the Blight.
InProgressResponse: Blight cannot be allowed to take hold here in Reekwater. The stakes are too high.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Good to see you back in one piece. Let us hope that your actions today helped curb the Blight. It is a great relief to learn it hasn't spread to Fisher's Glory.

Title: Burden of Atonement
Description: Take the Dryad Offering to the Mysterious Altar in Fisher's Glory as an apology. Then report to Herbalist Langlais in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It is not difficult. Place this offering on the altar at the foot of Fisher's Glory, so they all can see it.
InProgressResponse: I appreciate you humoring me with this penance. Marsh Walker Afolabi would say we're wasting our time, but time will tell.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah, I can sense some measure of serenity returning to the marshes. You have done the right thing, regardless of what anyone else says.

Title: Upstream Investigation
Description: Search Sha Makogai and the fallen lighthouse, Hingatirn, for any clues on the Dryads' presence in Reekwater. Then report to Herbalist Langlais in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: For the water, you say? She really believes it's to bathe themselves in the Azoth-infused waters here?
InProgressResponse: I'm convinced that the Ancient ruins will give us insights. If you don't find anything at first, just… keep trying.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So you found something then? Let's see... oh dear, this is quite dreadful!

Title: The Eternal Pool (Elite)
Description: Investigate the Eternal Pool and face whatever challenges lie within. Then report to Herbalist Langlais in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Absolutely. It appears to be on the northern plateau, and that is indeed a place the Dryads protect quite fiercely.
InProgressResponse: There could be anything waiting for you up on the plateau. Best gather some friends and watch yourself.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You... returned. I can't even imagine what you must've witnessed there. The pool is pure Azoth, isn't it?

Title: The Dryad Promenade (Elite)
Description: Follow the Dryad Promenade path into the depths of the Eternal Pool, and lay the Protector of the Source to rest.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The Protector of the Source exceeds his mandate - the pool belongs to all life forms.
InProgressResponse: To defeat the Protector of the Source, I would suggest you bring allies.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: [BLANK]
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: The Eternal Pool causes the Protector of the Source to regenerate faster than expected. Soon enough you'll be needed to push back against their expansion in Reekwater.

Title: The Original Guardian (Expedition)
Description: Collect the Guardian's Eye from Chardis in the Lazarus Well Expedition. Then report to Legatus Fulvius in the Reekwater Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I'm not entirely sure, but some of the glyphs show images of a massive, many-eyed Ancient Guardian.
InProgressResponse: If you can get me the eye of that Original Guardian, this journey won't have been a waste after all.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You survived the Lazarus Well? After you left, I deciphered clues suggesting it was even more dangerous than I knew.

Title: Death's Demise
Description: The druid Eoin Dornoll seeks help in retrieving 3 ancient hearts of enemies within Lazarus Instrumentalitry so that he can study how the Ancients corrupted the natrual order and created immortality.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It is said this is where the Ancients committed their most egregious crimes against the natural order. This is where they broke the cycles of life and death.
InProgressResponse: For the sake of all those eternally suffering on Aeternum, I need those hearts.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Yes, I believe these hearts are exactly what I needed… they stink of the foul magics the Ancients used for their... historic atrocity.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: The earth hums in gratitude for your services. I am studying the hearts you have retrieved but their lifeblood is finite. Come back later and I'll have another task for you.
